App.Title: USB Loader NX
App.ServiceUnavailable: USB Loader NX is not running. Make sure the Atmosphère from this package is installed and the console was restarted, and that atmosphere/config/system_settings.ini does not have enable = u8!0x0 under [usbloadernx].

Library.NoGames: No games found. Plug in a USB drive with a usbloadernx/games folder.
Library.NoMatch: No game matches “{{QUERY}}”. Press B to clear the search.

Game.PlugInDrive: Plug in its drive to play
Game.PartsElsewhere: Update or DLC on another drive: move it next to the game
Game.UpdateMissing: Missing the update this game was played with
Game.UpdateMissingHelp: This game was played on a newer version, and the console will not start it without that update. Put the update back on the same drive as the game. If HOME offers to download it, choose Cancel.
Game.PartsElsewhereHelp: Its update or DLC is on another drive, so it is not used: the game runs without it. Move the files to the same drive as the game and plug it in again.

Drives.Title: USB drives
Drives.Unreadable: Cannot be read. Use exFAT or FAT32.
Drives.AlmostFull: Almost full. Free some space before copying more games.

Settings.Title: Settings
Settings.AutoRegister: Show USB games on the HOME Menu
Settings.AutoRegisterHelp: Registers each game found, with its updates and DLCs.
Settings.HideWhenRemoved: Hide games while their drive is unplugged
Settings.HideWhenRemovedHelp: Their icons come back when the drive is plugged in again.
Settings.BadgeHelp: Shows on the HOME Menu where each game is loaded from.
Settings.NotificationsHelp: Tells when a drive is plugged in or removed.
Settings.NeedsAutoRegister: Only applies while USB games are shown on the HOME Menu.
Settings.SoundsHelp: Sounds when moving, opening and choosing in the Manager.
Settings.ThemeHelp: Colors, sounds and look. Themes go in config/usbloadernx-manager/themes on the SD card.
Settings.MusicHelp: Plays the theme's background music, under the sound effects.
Settings.MusicUnavailable: The chosen theme has no music.
Settings.SectionHomeHelp: How the drive's games show up on the console.
Settings.SectionManagerHelp: The Manager's sounds, music and look.
Settings.MusicVolumeHelp: Left and Right set it; the sound effects keep their volume.
Settings.HomebrewAccessHelp: Homebrew read the usbloadernx/usb folder of each USB drive (read only) at sdmc:/usbloadernx/usb/<volume serial>/. Games are not affected.
Settings.NeedsNewerModule: Needs USB Loader NX 1.1 or newer in Atmosphère.

About.Summary: Play your Nintendo Switch dumps straight from a USB drive.
About.License: Free software under the GNU GPL v2. Based on Atmosphère.

Errors.LaunchFailed: The game could not be launched ({{CODE}}).
Errors.UpdateRequired: This game was played on a newer version, and the console will not start it without that update. Put the update back on the same drive as the game. If HOME offers to download it, choose Cancel.
Errors.ActionFailed: The action could not be completed ({{CODE}}).

System.NotOurAtmosphereTitle: This Atmosphère does not have USB Loader NX
System.NotOurAtmosphere: The console is running Atmosphère {{VERSION}} (commit {{COMMIT}}), without USB Loader NX. Copy the SD folder of the USB Loader NX package over the SD card and restart the console.
System.DisabledTitle: USB Loader NX is turned off
System.Disabled: Open {{FILE}} on the SD card and, under [usbloadernx], set enable = u8!0x1. Then restart the console. That is the file your boot option reads.
System.DisabledRestart: {{FILE}} already turns it on. Restart the console to start USB Loader NX.
System.EnableFailed: {{FILE}} could not be changed ({{CODE}}). Change it on a computer: under [usbloadernx], enable = u8!0x1.
System.NotStartedTitle: USB Loader NX did not start
System.NotStarted: Atmosphère {{VERSION}} (commit {{COMMIT}}) has USB Loader NX turned on, but it is not running. See usbloadernx/logs/usbloadernx.log on the SD card, and make sure the Atmosphère and the Manager come from the same package.
System.VersionMismatchTitle: USB Loader NX and the Manager do not match
System.NewerConfig: usbloadernx/config.ini was written by a newer version of USB Loader NX. The options can be read but are not saved, so nothing that version set is lost. Write anyway to change them with this version.
System.NewerData: Some files in usbloadernx/data were written by a newer version of USB Loader NX; they are read but not changed (hidden games cannot be changed until you update).
System.NewerManager: usbloadernx/manager.ini was written by a newer Manager. Changes to the Manager's options last until you close it.
System.ModuleTooOld: The USB Loader NX in Atmosphère is older than this Manager ({{MANAGER}}). Copy the atmosphere folder from the same package as this Manager over the SD card and restart the console. Until then, the Manager changes nothing.
System.ModuleOlder: The USB Loader NX in Atmosphère ({{MODULE}}) is older than this Manager ({{MANAGER}}). Copy the atmosphere folder from the same package as this Manager over the SD card and restart the console. Until then, the Manager changes nothing.
System.ModuleNewer: This Manager ({{MANAGER}}) is older than the USB Loader NX in Atmosphère ({{MODULE}}). Copy switch/USBLoaderNX-Manager.nro from the same package as the Atmosphère to the SD card. Until then, the Manager changes nothing.
